targets.valid_target: mostly intact skeleton for skeleton creation
mostly intact corpse for zombie creation

effects.summary: Animates dead remains as obedient skeletons or zombies that follow spoken commands.
effects.effect: Animate up to 2 x caster level Hit Dice of undead per casting.
Skeletons have Hit Dice equal to the creature's Hit Dice in life.
Human and demi-human skeletons always have 1 Hit Die regardless of the deceased character's level.
Zombies have 1 more Hit Die than the creature had in life.

duration_rules.rule: Default duration is 1 day.
If made permanent, the undead remain animated until destroyed or dispelled.

procedure.step: Touch the remains to be animated.
Choose skeleton or zombie according to the condition of the remains.
Optionally sprinkle 1 vial of unholy water per Hit Die on each undead created to make the spell permanent.

effects.summary: Creates a personal barrier around the caster that blocks spells and spell-like effects from entering or leaving.
effects.effect: The shell blocks the caster's spells and spell-like effects as well as others'.

Spell-like effects are effects that duplicate a spell or magical effects resisted with a save versus Spells or Staffs & Wands, excluding effects that do not duplicate a spell and are resisted with saves versus Poison, Breath, Paralysis, or Petrification.
Self-range spells and touch-range spells used by the caster on himself are not blocked.

interactions.rule: If a creature or item with an ongoing spell or spell-like effect enters the shell, that effect is dispelled as if by dispel magic.
Effects that cannot be dispelled, such as magic weapon bonuses, are unaffected.
An anti-magic shell cannot itself be dispelled.

duration_rules.rule: The effect ends when the duration expires or when the caster chooses to end it.

targets.requirement: The subject must be truly repentant and desirous of setting right its misdeeds.

effects.summary: Removes the burden of unwilling evil acts or misdeeds from the subject.
effects.effect: May reverse magical alignment change.

effects.summary: Reveals whether a contemplated action will bring good or bad results in the immediate future.

procedure.step: The caster asks about a particular action.
The Judge secretly rolls for accuracy.
The response reflects only consequences within the next 3 turns.

scaling.rule: Base chance for a true reply is 70% + 1% per caster level.

limits.limit: The spell only sees 3 turns into the future.
Long-term consequences are not considered.

effects.summary: Before battle, grants the caster and allies bonuses in combat and morale.
effects.bonus: +1 morale rolls for allied monsters or NPCs.

limits.limit: Cannot be cast on creatures already engaged in melee.

special.rule: Divine spellcasters of 7th level or higher may instead transform 1 pint of ordinary water into holy water.
Creating holy water requires a sacrifice worth at least 10gp.
Holy water retains potency indefinitely if kept in the vial it was blessed in.

reversed_form.name: Bane

effects.summary: Applies fear and doubt to the caster's enemies within a 50' radius.

reversed_form.special: Chaotic divine casters of 7th level or higher may, with a sacrifice of at least 10gp, create 1 vial of unholy water; unholy water is beneficial in animating the dead.

effects.summary: Charms an animal in a manner similar to charm person.

saving_throw.rule: Unintelligent animals receive no saving throw when the spell is cast.
Intelligent animals, such as great apes or whales, may save to resist.
After being charmed, the animal receives repeat saves to break the spell: daily if 7+1 HD or more, weekly if 5-6 HD, monthly if 4 HD or fewer.

duration_rules.rule: The charm lasts until removed by dispel magic or until the animal succeeds on a repeat saving throw.

limits.limit: The spell does not provide any special means of communication with the animal.

interactions.rule: Combined with speak with animals, the spell becomes significantly more useful.

targets.option: Affect up to 3d6 Hit Dice of creatures of 4 or fewer Hit Dice.
Affect one creature of more than 4 Hit Dice.

effects.summary: Functions like charm person but without restriction by monster type or size.
effects.effect: Creatures with less than 1 HD count as 1/2 HD.
Creatures with bonus Hit Dice count the bonus as a flat amount.
In a mixed group, the caster chooses which creatures are affected first.
Excess Hit Dice of effect are ignored.

saving_throw.rule: Any targeted creature that succeeds on its save resists the effect.
After being charmed, the creature receives repeat saves: daily if 7+1 HD or more, weekly if 5-6 HD, monthly if 4 HD or fewer.
If the creature has INT 9 or more, it may save more frequently using charm person frequencies: daily at INT 13+, weekly at INT 9-12.

duration_rules.rule: The charm lasts until removed by dispel magic or until the creature succeeds on a repeat saving throw.

targets.valid_target: living humanoid creature no larger than an ogre and with 4 or fewer Hit Dice
humans and demi-humans regardless of character level
targets.rule: Humanoid creatures include bugbears, dryads, dwarves, elves, gnolls, gnomes, goblins, hobgoblins, kobolds, lizardmen, men, mermen, morlocks, neanderthal, naiads, ogres, pixies, sprites, troglodytes, and similar manlike creatures.

effects.summary: Makes the target regard the caster as a trusted friend and ally.
effects.effect: The spell does not grant automaton-like control.
The target interprets the caster's words and actions in the most favorable way.
The caster may attempt orders, but the target will not do something it would not ordinarily do.
The Judge may allow an additional saving throw against extraordinary orders.
If the caster is attacked, the charmed creature acts to protect its friend.

saving_throw.rule: If the target is currently threatened or attacked by the caster or the caster's allies, it gains a +5 bonus on its saving throw.
Repeat saves occur daily if INT 13 or greater, weekly if INT 9-12, monthly if INT 8 or less.

duration_rules.rule: The charm lasts until removed by dispel magic or until the target succeeds on a repeat saving throw.

limits.limit: The caster must speak the target's language to communicate commands, unless able to pantomime effectively.

targets.requirement: The caster must specify a direction and approximate distance up to 60'.
A living creature must be present in the chosen area.

effects.summary: Lets the caster see into another area through the eyes of a living creature there.
effects.effect: The target area need not be in line of sight.

saving_throw.rule: No saving throw is allowed.
The subject is unaware of being used.

duration_rules.rule: After at least 1 turn has passed, the caster may choose a different subject creature and view a different location.
If the subject creature moves out of range, contact is lost.

limits.limit: A lead barrier between caster and subject blocks the effect.
If no appropriate creature is in the chosen area, the spell fails.

effects.summary: Creates a moving cloud of poisonous gas.
effects.effect: The cloud spreads from the caster's fingertips and moves 20' per round away from the caster.
The gas is heavier than air and sinks down holes or slides downhill.
Trees or thick vegetation break up the cloud.
effects.damage: Creatures with 5 or more Hit Dice or levels take 1 point of damage each round they remain within the cloud.

saving_throw.rule: Each round a creature of fewer than 5 Hit Dice or levels remains within the cloud, it must save or die.
Even on a successful save, such creatures still take 1 point of damage that round.

duration_rules.rule: The cloud persists for the full duration even if the caster stops concentrating.

targets.requirement: The caster must be able to speak the target's language.

effects.summary: Compels the target to obey a single-word command to the best of its ability.
effects.effect: The command must make sense as a single word.
The command "die" causes the target to faint for 1 round rather than die.

saving_throw.rule: Targets with more than 5 HD or INT over 12 receive a saving throw.

effects.summary: Puts the caster in contact with great powers that answer yes-or-no questions.
effects.effect: The contacted being answers 3 yes-or-no questions.

limits.limit: The spell may be performed only once per week.

special.rule: The contacted being may not be omniscient and may answer unclearly or incompletely at the Judge's discretion.
Once per year, possibly on the patron deity's feast day, the caster may ask twice the normal number of questions.

spell.name: Confusion
spell.area: 30' radius circle around the target point

effects.summary: Causes affected creatures to lose the ability to determine their actions independently.

saving_throw.rule: Creatures with 2 or fewer Hit Dice receive no saving throw.
Creatures with more than 2 Hit Dice may save to resist.

procedure.step: On each confused creature's initiative, roll 2d6.
Consult the confusion behavior table.
If the indicated action cannot be carried out, the creature babbles incoherently instead.
A confused creature attacked by another creature automatically retaliates on its next turn if still confused.

row.behavior: Attack the caster or the caster's allies with melee or ranged weapons, or move closer if attack is not possible.
Attack the creature's own party, if any.

spell.special: No special advantage is gained when attacking a confused creature.

effects.summary: Opens a portal to an Elemental Plane and summons an elemental of Air, Earth, Fire, or Water.
effects.effect: Once summoned, the elemental serves indefinitely while the caster concentrates solely on controlling it.

duration_rules.rule: Spellcasting, combat, or movement above half normal rate causes loss of concentration.
If concentration is lost, control is lost permanently.

limits.limit: At most one elemental of each type may be summoned by the caster per day.

interactions.rule: The caster may dismiss a controlled elemental to its native plane at will, on the caster's initiative in combat.
An uncontrolled elemental attacks the conjurer and all others in its path.
Once uncontrolled, only dispel magic or dispel evil can banish it.
An uncontrolled elemental may choose on its own to return home and will not remain on the Material Plane for long.

effects.summary: Sends the caster's mind to another plane to ask one-word questions of extraplanar powers.
effects.effect: Answers are brief and in a language the caster understands.
Possible answers include yes, no, maybe, never, irrelevant, or another one-word answer.

procedure.step: Before casting, choose the number of questions to ask, from 3 to 12.
Maintain concentration and ask questions at the rate of 1 per round.
For each question, first determine whether the contacted power knows the answer.
Then determine whether the answer given is true.
After casting, check for insanity.

special.rule: The more questions asked, the farther away and more powerful the contacted being.
Do not know: the entity may or may not know and may or may not reveal whether it knows.
True answer: if this roll fails, the entity lies and the lie is undetectable.
Insanity lasts for a number of weeks equal to the number of questions asked, and the player cannot play the character during that time.
Reduce the insanity chance by 5% for each caster level above 11.

spell.name: Continual Light *
spell.area: 30' radius full daylight, 60' radius lesser illumination

effects.summary: Creates a sustained sphere of light.
effects.effect: May be cast on an object, into the air, or at a creature.
If cast on a creature's visual organs, it can blind the creature.

saving_throw.rule: A creature targeted for blinding may save.
On a successful save, the spell is cast into the air just behind the target.
On a failed save, the blinded creature suffers a -4 penalty to attack throws.

duration_rules.rule: Continual light and continual darkness are indefinitely sustained by the caster without concentration.
A caster may indefinitely sustain one continual light or continual darkness spell per level of experience.
Any blindness caused by either form ends when the spell ends.

spell.special: A truly permanent light requires a permanency ritual.

effects.summary: Creates complete absence of light in the area and overpowers normal light sources.
effects.effect: May be used to blind as continual light does.

effects.summary: Creates a chosen weather condition around the caster.

duration_rules.rule: Duration is indefinite while the caster remains stationary and concentrating.

limits.limit: Outdoor use only.

row.effects: Dries wet conditions; all movement divided by 2.
Water and mud freeze; all movement divided by 2.

All movement divided by 2; no flying or missile weapon use possible; sandy conditions reduce visibility to 20'; ship speed increases or decreases depending on whether sailing with or against the wind.

The caster directs the tornado, which moves 120' per round and attacks using the characteristics of a 12 HD air elemental; sea vessels have a 75% chance of suffering 8+1d4 structural hit points damage.
Visibility drops to 20'; all movement divided by 2.
Missile attacks at -2; mud forms in 3 turns; movement divided by 2.
Visibility drops to 20'; all movement divided by 2.

effects.summary: Creates simple but nourishing food.
effects.effect: Feeds up to 12 men and their mounts for 1 day.

scaling.rule: For each caster level above 8th, create enough food for 12 additional men and their mounts.

duration_rules.rule: The food becomes inedible within 24 hours.
Purify food and water keeps the food fresh for an additional 24 hours.

effects.summary: Creates an enchanted spring from the ground or wall.
effects.effect: Provides enough water for 12 men and their mounts for 1 day.
Creates 50 gallons of clean rain-water-like water.

scaling.rule: For each caster level above 8th, supply 12 additional men and mounts.

limits.limit: Appropriate vessels to contain the water must be available when the spell is cast.

special.rule: Water weighs about 1 stone per gallon.
One cubic foot of water is roughly 8 gallons.

effects.summary: Cures blindness caused by injury or magic.
effects.effect: Can cure blindness caused by light or continual light.

limits.limit: Cannot cure blindness caused by a curse.

effects.summary: Cures disease affecting the subject.
effects.effect: Cures all diseases the subject is suffering from, including lycanthropy and mummy rot.
Kills green slime and other parasites afflicting the target.

limits.limit: Some special diseases may not be countered, or may require a caster of a certain level or higher.
Does not prevent reinfection after new exposure.

effects.summary: Infects the target with a wasting plague.
effects.effect: The target cannot be magically healed while afflicted.
The target naturally heals at half the normal rate.
The disease is fatal in 2d12 days unless cure disease is cast on the victim.

effects.summary: Heals injury by touch.
effects.effect: May instead cure paralysis, but then heals no hit points.

limits.limit: Cannot raise a creature above its normal hit point maximum.

reversed_form.name: Cause Light Wounds

effects.summary: Deals damage by touch.

procedure.step: Make a successful attack throw against the target.

reversed_form.special: Undead are affected in reverse: cure light wounds injures undead, while cause light wounds heals undead.

effects.summary: Functions like cure light wounds with greater healing.
effects.healing: Restore 2d6 hit points plus 1 point per caster level.

effects.summary: Functions like cause light wounds with greater damage.

procedure.step: Resolve as cause light wounds, including the required successful attack throw.

spell.name: Death Spell
spell.area: 30' radius sphere centered anywhere within range

effects.summary: Kills a limited total of creature Hit Dice within the area.
effects.effect: The spell kills up to 4d8 Hit Dice of creatures.
If more Hit Dice are present than can be killed, the weakest creatures die first.
Hit Dice insufficient to affect a creature are wasted.

saving_throw.rule: Each affected creature may save to avoid death.

limits.limit: Creatures of 8 or more Hit Dice or levels are immune.
Undead, golems, and any other creature that is not truly alive are immune.

effects.summary: Delays the effects of poison rather than curing it.
effects.effect: The subject is temporarily immune to poison during the spell.
Any poison already in the subject or encountered during the duration has no effect until the spell ends.
If cast within 1 turn per caster level after a subject dies from poison, the subject is restored to life for the spell's duration at 1 hp.

duration_rules.rule: When the spell ends, apply pending poison effects, including saving throws and damage, unless the poison has been cured.
A revived character dies again when the spell ends unless the poison has been cured first.

limits.limit: Does not heal damage poison has already caused.

effects.summary: Allows the caster to detect evil.
effects.effect: Detects creatures with evil intentions.
Detects magic items with evil enchantments.
Detects undead.
Detects sinkholes of evil.
Detects summoned creatures of Chaotic alignment.
The caster sees detected evil as a definite red glow visible only to the caster.

limits.limit: Normal Chaotic characters are not detected unless they have actively evil intentions against the caster.
Poisons, physical traps, and natural animals are not detected.

effects.summary: Works as detect evil but detects good enchantments, good intentions, and summoned creatures of Lawful alignment.
Allows the caster to see invisible characters, creatures, and objects as translucent shapes.
Lets the caster see enchanted or enspelled objects and creatures.
effects.effect: Detected magic appears as a pale glowing yellow light visible only to the caster.
Invisible creatures and objects are not directly detected.
The emanations of invisibility magic appear as an amorphous glowing fog.

interactions.rule: The caster may be able to attack an invisible creature detected only by its invisibility emanations at a -2 attack penalty.

targets.option: Any single target creature within range.

effects.summary: Instantly transports the subject to another location.
effects.effect: The destination may be any spot within 360' of the caster's or target creature's present location.
The subject arrives exactly at the desired location, whether chosen by visualization or by stated direction and distance.
Anything worn or carried is transported.
A transported creature may carry another creature if it can lift it.

saving_throw.rule: An unwilling target may save to avoid transport.

limits.limit: If the destination lies within a solid object, the spell fails automatically.

targets.target: one object up to a 10' x 10' x 10' cube of material

effects.summary: Projects a ray that disintegrates the target into fine dust.
effects.effect: A disintegrated creature's equipment is unaffected.

saving_throw.rule: A creature that succeeds on its save is unaffected.

limits.limit: The ray can target only one creature per casting.
If the targeted creature saves, the spell is wasted.

effects.summary: Radiates destructive holy power against undead and enchanted creatures.
effects.effect: The caster may instead direct the spell at one monster only.

saving_throw.rule: Undead and enchanted creatures entering within 30' must save or be destroyed.
On a successful save, such creatures flee the affected area.
If directed at one monster, that monster saves at -2.

duration_rules.rule: The caster may take no other action and must concentrate for the entire duration.

interactions.rule: Casting the spell on an unholy place or shrine can sometimes rid it of evil, at the Judge's discretion.
The spell may be used to remove a cursed item from a being within range; doing so discharges and ends the spell.

spell.name: Dispel Magic
spell.area: 20' cube when cast as an area effect

effects.summary: Ends ongoing spells and spell-like effects.
effects.effect: If targeted at a creature, may cancel all spells and spell-like effects on that creature, including ongoing potion effects.
If targeted at an area, may cancel such effects within the area.

procedure.step: Choose creature/object target or area target.
Effects cast by a character of equal or lower level than the dispeller end automatically.
For each higher-level effect, there is a 5% chance of failure for each level the effect exceeds the caster's level.

limits.limit: Cannot end magical disease.
Cannot end geas.
Cannot end quest.
Cannot undo petrification from flesh to stone.
Cannot remove curses, including bestow curse and cursed items.

effects.summary: Provides useful advice regarding a specific goal, event, or activity expected within 1 week.
effects.effect: The advice may be a short phrase, cryptic rhyme, or omen.
If the caster does not act on the information, changing conditions may make it useless.

scaling.rule: Base chance for a correct divination is 60% + 1% per caster level.

procedure.step: The Judge secretly rolls for correctness.
If the roll fails, the information received is false.

effects.summary: Lets the caster detect the surface thoughts of one or more targets.
effects.effect: Thoughts are understood regardless of language.

procedure.step: Choose a direction.
Concentrate for 1 turn to hear thoughts in that direction.
Each turn, the caster may choose a new direction.
The caster may stop and resume listening later, provided the duration has not expired.

saving_throw.rule: A target normally does not notice the intrusion.
If a target is aware of being spied upon, it may save to clear its thoughts and avoid detection.

limits.limit: Rock more than 2 inches thick blocks the spell.
A thin coating of lead or gold blocks the spell.
Undead are immune.
Mindless creatures such as golems are immune.

effects.summary: Outlines creatures or objects in a pale flickering fire.
effects.effect: The fire causes no damage.
effects.bonus: All attacks against an outlined target gain +2 to attack throws.

targets.requirement: The subject need only be detected in some way, such as with detect magic.

scaling.rule: The caster can outline 1 man-sized creature, about 12' of fire, for every 5 levels of experience, rounded up.

effects.summary: Reduces the subject to helpless idiocy.
effects.effect: The target cannot cast spells, understand language, communicate coherently, or fight effectively.
The target dimly remembers its friends and may follow simple instructions.

saving_throw.rule: A target creature that can cast arcane spells suffers a -4 penalty on its saving throw.

duration_rules.rule: The effect lasts until canceled by dispel magic.

targets.option: Another willing creature of equal or fewer levels or Hit Dice than the caster.
targets.requirement: Physical contact is required to affect another creature.

effects.summary: Places the subject in a death-like paralytic arrest.
effects.effect: The state mimics death to any observer, even on physical examination.
The subject remains conscious and can hear and smell, but cannot move and is completely numb.
Damage to the subject is reduced by 50%.
Poison, paralysis, and energy drain attacks are ineffective during the spell.

saving_throw.rule: No saving throw is permitted.

duration_rules.rule: If poison affecting the subject still has duration remaining when the spell ends, it takes effect when the spell ends or is negated.
The caster may negate the spell early, but 1 round must pass for the body to resume normal life functions.

effects.summary: Alters others' social reactions to the caster.
effects.effect: Creatures failing their save are very impressed, desire friendship, and assist the caster as they can.
Creatures who do not fail the save are uneasy and tend to find the caster irritating.

saving_throw.rule: All creatures that socially interact with the caster must save.
On failure, they treat the caster as though Charisma were 2d4 points higher.
On success, they treat the caster as though Charisma were 1d4 points lower.

limits.limit: Has no effect on creatures of animal intelligence or lower.

effects.summary: Detects magical and mechanical traps.
effects.effect: When the caster comes within 30' of a trap, it glows with a faint blue aura.

limits.limit: Does not detect natural hazards such as quicksand, sinkholes, or unsafe natural rock walls.
Does not reveal how to disarm a trap.
Does not reveal the trap's type or nature.

effects.summary: Creates an explosion of flame at the chosen point of detonation.
effects.damage: Deals 1d6 fire damage per caster level to every creature in the area.
effects.effect: The explosion creates almost no pressure.
Sets combustibles on fire and damages objects in the area.
Can melt metals with low melting points, including lead, gold, copper, silver, and bronze.

procedure.step: Point and choose the distance and height where the fireball is to burst.
A glowing bead travels to that point unless it strikes a material body or solid barrier first.
If it strikes early, it detonates early.
To pass through a narrow opening such as an arrow slit, make a missile attack throw without range adjustments; failure causes premature detonation against the barrier.
If an interposing barrier is shattered or broken through by the damage, the fireball may continue beyond it to attain full volume.

spell.name: Flame Strike
spell.area: vertical column 30' high and 10' in diameter

effects.summary: Calls down a column of divine fire on a target.
Turns the target and all carried gear into an inert stone statue.
effects.effect: If the statue is broken or damaged, the target suffers corresponding damage or deformity if restored.

limits.limit: Dispel magic does not undo flesh to stone.

effects.summary: Restores a creature petrified by flesh to stone or similar petrification effects.
effects.effect: When used on ordinary stone not created by petrification, it converts a man-sized volume of stone into a gooey pile of organic matter.

effects.summary: Creates an invisible concave plane of force for carrying loads.
effects.effect: The disc is 3' in diameter and 1" deep at the center.
Maximum load is 50 stone (500 lb).
The disc floats level with the ground at about the caster's waist height.
It remains still when within 10' of the caster and follows at the caster's movement rate when the caster moves away.
The disc may be pushed as needed to position it.

limits.limit: Items must be properly supported or they fall off.
If moved more than 10' from the caster by other means, the disc is dispelled.

duration_rules.rule: When the spell ends, the disc disappears and drops its load onto the surface beneath.

special.rule: Water weighs about 1 stone per gallon.
Just over 62 gallons may be carried if held in a suitable container.

effects.summary: Allows the subject to fly freely.
effects.movement: Movement up to 120' per round (360' per turn) in any direction.
effects.effect: Flying requires only as much concentration as walking.
The subject may attack or cast spells normally while flying.

limits.limit: The subject cannot carry more weight than its maximum load aloft.

interactions.rule: If fly is dispelled, the subject plummets from the air.

targets.requirement: The target must be able to understand the caster.

effects.summary: Places a magical command on the target to perform or avoid a course of action.
effects.effect: Cannot compel suicide or certain death, but can compel almost any other activity.
The target may choose to accept the geas voluntarily, such as as part of a bargain.

saving_throw.rule: An unwilling target may save when the geas is first cast.

duration_rules.rule: The target must obey until the geas is completed, however long that takes.
If the task is open-ended and cannot be completed by the target's own actions, the geas lasts for a maximum of 1 day per caster level.
A subject who resumes obedience has all penalties removed 24 hours later.

special.rule: A creature ignoring a geas suffers cumulative penalties determined by the Judge until obedience resumes or the creature dies.
Appropriate penalties include combat penalties, lowered ability scores, loss of spells, pain, and weakness ending in death.
A clever subject may subvert some instructions.

interactions.rule: Remove curse, wish, or the reverse spell remove geas can end a geas and all its effects.
There is a 5% chance such removal fails for each level the removing caster is lower than the caster who imposed the geas.
Dispel magic does not affect geas.

spell.name: Glyph of Warding
spell.area: up to 5' squared per caster level; inscription proceeds at up to 10' squared per round

effects.summary: Creates an almost invisible magical ward that harms intruders.
effects.effect: The caster sets a password when casting.
Any creature entering or touching the warded area or opening the warded object without speaking the password triggers the stored effect.
The glyph may be shaped freely within the allowed total square footage.

procedure.step: Trace faintly glowing lines around the warding sigil during casting.
Choose either a blast glyph or a spell glyph.
Set the password.
When casting completes, the glyph and tracery become nearly invisible.

special.rule: Blast glyph: deals 2 points of fire or electricity damage per caster level to intruders.
Spell glyph: stores a harmful spell such as one causing blindness, paralysis, energy drain, or similar effects.
The cleric must be high enough level to cast the stored spell.

saving_throw.rule: Blast glyph allows a save versus Spells for half damage.
Spell glyph allows an appropriate saving throw based on the stored spell.

effects.summary: Enlarges an animal and its equipment.
effects.effect: The animal becomes twice normal size and eight times normal weight.
The animal deals double normal damage with all physical attacks.
The animal's natural Armor Class improves by 2.
The animal's carrying capacity doubles.
Equipment worn or carried enlarges as well, but any enlarged item returning to other possession instantly returns to normal size.

saving_throw.rule: Unfriendly animals may save to resist.
Domesticated animals normally do not resist, though they may become confused or panicked afterward at the Judge's discretion.

limits.limit: The spell does not provide command or influence over the enlarged animals.

effects.summary: Causes normal vegetation to become thick and overgrown.
effects.effect: The caster chooses the exact dimensions up to the maximum area.
The resulting thicket is impassable to creatures smaller than giant size.
Creatures of less than giant size may hack through at up to 5' per round.
Giant-sized creatures move at half normal rate through the growth.

limits.limit: The area must already contain brush and/or trees.
The spell has no effect on animated plant creatures.

interactions.rule: The spell and its reverse are permanent until countered by the opposite form or by dispel magic.

effects.summary: Renders overgrown areas passable.
effects.effect: The area of effect is the same as the normal version.

effects.summary: Makes outdoor terrain appear to be a different natural terrain type.
effects.effect: The altered terrain looks, sounds, and smells like the chosen terrain.

targets.requirement: The entire terrain feature to be disguised must be within range.

saving_throw.rule: A save is allowed only to creatures that actively attempt to see through the illusion.

duration_rules.rule: The illusion ends when touched by an intelligent creature moving into the hallucinatory terrain.

effects.summary: Speeds up affected creatures.
effects.effect: Affected creatures move and act twice as quickly as normal.
Movement rates double.
Attacks per round double.
Spellcasting is not accelerated.
Magic items such as wands may still be used only once per round.

limits.limit: Multiple haste or speed effects do not stack; apply only the most powerful or longest-lasting effect.

interactions.rule: Haste and slow dispel each other.

effects.summary: Reduces affected creatures' speed and action rate.
effects.effect: Affected creatures move at half speed.
Affected creatures attack half as often, generally every other round.
Affected creatures make only half a normal move each round.

saving_throw.rule: Targets may save to avoid the effect.

special.rule: Each application of haste causes permanent aging: humans 1 year, dwarves 2 years, elves 5 years.
The aging may be reversed only by effects such as wish or potion of longevity.

effects.summary: Paralyzes a living creature.
effects.effect: The spell functions like hold person, but is not limited to humanoids.

targets.valid_target: living non-undead humanoid creature no larger than an ogre and with 4 or fewer Hit Dice
humans and demi-humans regardless of character level
targets.rule: Humanoid creatures include bugbears, dryads, dwarves, elves, gnolls, gnomes, goblins, hobgoblins, kobolds, lizardmen, men, mermen, morlocks, neanderthal, naiads, ogres, pixies, sprites, troglodytes, and similar creatures.

effects.summary: Paralyzes the target while leaving awareness and breathing intact.
effects.effect: Paralyzed targets cannot take any actions, including speech.
A winged creature falls if paralyzed in flight.
A paralyzed swimmer cannot swim and may drown.

saving_throw.rule: If cast at a single person, that person saves at -2.

targets.valid_target: door, gate, window, or shutter of wood, metal, or stone

effects.summary: Magically holds a portal shut.
effects.effect: The portal is treated as securely closed and normally locked.

limits.limit: A thief cannot attempt Pick Locks on a held portal.

interactions.rule: Knock negates the spell.
A successful dispel magic negates the spell.

effects.summary: Continuous chant grants allies supernatural aid and hinders enemies.
effects.bonus: Allied attack throws, damage rolls, and saving throws gain +1.
effects.penalty: Enemy attack throws, damage rolls, and saving throws suffer -1.

duration_rules.rule: The effect continues while the caster remains stationary and focuses only on chanting.
The spell ends if the caster is successfully attacked and damaged, or otherwise physically distracted.

interactions.rule: Silence 15' radius negates the spell.

effects.summary: Grants the subject the ability to see in the dark to 60'.
Summons a controllable plague of swarming insects.
effects.effect: The plague consists of 4 insect swarms, each with 4 Hit Dice.
The swarms must be placed so each is adjacent to at least one other swarm, filling one contiguous area.
The swarms may be summoned in spaces already occupied by other creatures.
Each swarm attacks creatures in its area.
The whole plague obscures vision.
Creatures of less than 3 Hit Dice are automatically driven off.

duration_rules.rule: The caster must concentrate to maintain control for the spell's duration.
The caster loses control if successfully attacked or if the plague leaves spell range.
While controlled, the constituent swarms may be moved 20' per round.
Once control is lost, the swarms become stationary.

effects.summary: Makes the touched creature or object invisible, including to infravision.
effects.effect: A creature's carried gear becomes invisible as well.
When cast on another creature, the caster and allies cannot see the subject unless they can normally see invisible things or use magic to do so.
Items dropped or put down become visible.
Items picked up disappear if tucked into clothing or pouches worn by the creature.
Light does not become invisible, though an invisible light source has no visible source.
Any part of an item extending more than 10' from the subject becomes visible.
The spell does not silence the subject, and mundane traces may still reveal it.

duration_rules.rule: The spell ends if the subject attacks any creature or casts any spell.
Actions directed at unattended objects do not end the spell unless they involve spellcasting.
Indirect harm is not considered an attack for ending the spell.
Maximum duration is 24 hours.

effects.summary: Functions like invisibility but affects all creatures within 10' of the recipient.
effects.effect: The center of the effect moves with the recipient.
Affected creatures can see themselves and each other as though unaffected.

duration_rules.rule: Creatures already within the area when the spell is cast become invisible.
Creatures entering the area later do not become invisible.
An affected creature other than the recipient that attacks loses invisibility only for itself.
If the recipient attacks, the invisibility ends for all affected creatures.
A creature moving out of the area becomes visible.

interactions.rule: The spell otherwise functions as invisibility.

spell.name: Invisible Stalker

effects.summary: Summons an invisible stalker to perform the caster's bidding.
effects.effect: The stalker appears anywhere within range.

duration_rules.rule: The spell lasts until dispel evil is cast on the stalker, the stalker is slain, or the assigned task is completed.

spell.special: The invisible stalker may not always be a reliable servant; consult its monster entry when adjudicating service.
